extracted.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
extracted.description: This easy Egg Roll in a Bowl recipe is on the table in just 20 minutes! This healthy meal has a flavorful ground pork mixture with shredded cabbage, served over hot cooked rice and topped with green onions.
ingredient_lines: 1 lb ground pork (, or ground turkey, chicken, beef or cooked shrimp)
½ fresh jalapeño pepper (, seeds and veins removed, minced (optional))
2 Tablespoons low-sodium soy sauce (, or liquid aminos)
1/2 cup fresh basil leaves (, chopped, (Thai or holy basil preferred))
Cooked white rice or cauliflower rice
Hot sauce - sambal oelek, gochujang, or sriracha
instruction_lines: Brown meat: Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add ground meat and cook, chopping into small pieces until browned. Season with fresh cracked black pepper. Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, then remove everything to a bowl.
Add veggies: Add sesame oil to the pan, then add onion and cook for 4 minutes. Add coleslaw mix and cook for a few more minutes, until wilted. Season with fresh cracked black pepper.
Finish: Add meat mixture back to pan. Stir in soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and rice vinegar.
Serve garnished with green onions, cilantro and basil.
